name: lib_matrix_rank_pow_succ_lt_of_isNilpotent_of_ne_zero
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : IsNilpotent A) (k : ℕ) (hk : A ^ k ≠ 0) : (A ^ (k + 1)).rank < (A ^ k).rank
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : IsNilpotent A) (k : ℕ) (hk : A ^ k ≠ 0), (A ^ (k + 1)).rank < (A ^ k).rank
informal: promoted from Mathlib2.bld5_nilpotent_pow_rank_succ_eq_zero_aux2 (hypothesis restated as A^k ≠ 0 instead of rank ≠ 0): for a nilpotent matrix the ranks of the powers strictly decrease as long as the power is nonzero.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), IsNilpotent A → ∀ (k : ℕ), A ^ k ≠ 0 → (A ^ (k + 1)).rank < (A ^ k).rank
